monastic mountain cartographer, post-collapse, rendered as screenprint concept art moodboard, a pastel low-contrast grade, moss and lichen

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Lighting reference: underlighting from a translucent base panel.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
